spherical_reduction.essential_threshold: sigma_essential(K_ell)=[1,infinity) for every ell after proving relative compactness of the certified asymptotically-flat coefficient remainder
spherical_reduction.bound_spectrum_rule: all spectral mass in [alpha_min^2,1), including a finite or countably infinite set of eigenvalues accumulating only at 1, is retained by the spectral measure; a finite bound-pole inventory is not assumed

complete_spectral_measure.green_kernel: for z in C\[alpha_min^2,infinity), G_ell(z;r,r')=u_reg(z,r_<)*u_W(z,r_>)/W_ell(z), with the measure-weighted Wronskian fixed by the unit origin coefficient of u_reg and the unique Weyl solution u_W
complete_spectral_measure.recovery: rho_ell is recovered by Stieltjes inversion of the directed boundary values; atoms, absolutely continuous density and any threshold accumulation are parts of one measure
complete_spectral_measure.negative_axis_route: the finite proof program evaluates (K_ell+kappa^2)^(-1) for kappa>=0 using the regular origin and decaying infinity solutions plus certified Wronskians; this route has no physical-axis pole crossing because K>=alpha_min^2
complete_spectral_measure.mode_normalization_meaning: agreement on mode normalization means equality of the radial resolvent/spectral-measure pairing under dmu_r and the frozen unitary spherical-harmonic convention, not equality of arbitrary eigenfunction phases
complete_spectral_measure.threshold_duty: each lane certifies the absence or exact contribution of a lambda=1 resonance and encloses the complete spectral-measure remainder in a punctured threshold neighborhood; failure to decide is terminal
